general_summary: Sandro Ferreira architecture, is an architecture studio based in Braga, Portugal. Focused on achieving a perfect harmony between form, place and function, the studio develops strategic and pragmatic solutions, centered on the human relationship with space. The creative process is based on experimentation, maturation, strategy and theory, in order to create architecture with meaning and to create spaces that combine functionality and aesthetic appeal. The projects are based on good architectural practices and in partnership with all professionals involved in the project, in order to materialize the clients' aspirations.

Vasco is a native of Lisbon and began his artistic studies at the António Arroio School. He graduated from Lusíada University in Lisbon and moved to the North, completing his master's degree at the Porto School of Art. Along the way, he established numerous personal and professional relationships throughout the region and explored the diverse ways of practicing and understanding this craft in different regions. After spending five years in the job market, gaining experience through collaborations with various offices, the opportunity arose in 2019 to pursue the craft independently. "In this order, my architecture comes: from the place, the developer, the local society, and only then, the author. Thus, the categorization of a "style" or a "language" does not exist. In this methodology, there are no styles. The client's intention is pursued and the constraints are managed in that same order."

Founded in 2012, by the hands of its managing partners, the studio that we now know as Skemba – Arquitetura e Engenharia was born. Coming from two distinct but complementary areas, the founders identified an important market need. The objective is to reconcile, in a harmonious and efficient way, the areas of architecture and civil engineering. It is precisely here that we recognize one of our biggest challenges: the possibility of presenting our customers with a complete, functional and comprehensive solution. We are inspired by nature, people and life. We are detail-oriented, dreamy and realistic. We constantly seek the perfect balance between concept and execution.

Founded in 2012, HighPlan is a Lisbon-based firm of architects with extensive experience in the fields of architecture, urbanism and design.Its curriculum includes participation in structuring projects for various urban territories, namely Expo'98 - Lisbon International Exhibition, the conversion of Lisbon's eastern zone (Parque das Nações), various urban territory requalifications through the Polis Programme, international urban conversion studies (Brazil, Croatia, Italy, Paraguay) and the enhancement of historic centres (Russia).The projects we develop are based on integrated methodologies that ensure a macro-scale territorial vision, articulated with a micro-scale local territorial vision. All projects involve multidisciplinary teams made up of highly qualified professionals from a wide range of fields, such as geography, sociology, infrastructure, economics, landscape, marketing, among others, who contribute to the development of environmentally and economically sustainable solutions.HighPlan's orientation is to develop solutions for each challenge in an integrated way, with respect for the cultural appreciation of local society, the characteristics of the space in which it is integrated, the modernity of the time in which it is carried out and the economic efficiency of the project. read in Deutsch Português
